# OFFER brand assets

Brand marks identify their respective owners. Original local assets are retained. Brand marks are not a claim of partnership.

## Added on 2026-11-02

Vector paths from the Simple Icons v15 distribution (CC0 collection; marks remain subject to their owners’ rights). Color metadata and owner sources are retained below. Generated `-mark.svg` wrappers, `-panel.svg` thumbnails and transparent `-hero.svg` logo variants use these assets; no remote image requests are required at runtime.

- UNIQLO · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/uniqlo.svg · owner source: https://www.uniqlo.com
- H&M · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/handm.svg · owner source: https://www2.hm.com/en_gb/index.html
- PUMA · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/puma.svg · owner source: https://us.puma.com
- THE NORTH FACE · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/thenorthface.svg · owner source: https://www.thenorthface.com
- BURGER KING · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/burgerking.svg · owner source: https://www.bk.com
- McDonald’s · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/mcdonalds.svg · owner source: https://www.mcdonalds.com/gb/en-gb/newsroom.html
- KFC · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/kfc.svg · owner source: https://global.kfc.com/asset-library/
- FILA · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v15/icons/fila.svg · owner source: https://www.fila.com
